recommendationItems.name: Jawad Bokhari
recommendationItems.headline: Head of Engineering @ Expertflow
recommendationItems.relationship: Sir Jawad is the head of Engineering department
recommendationItems.text: Nabeel was a valuable and capable Software Engineer during his time with us at Expertflow. What stood out most was his consistency: he combined strong technical fundamentals with a genuine sense of ownership over the quality of what he shipped, never treating a task as done until it was done right. He approached problems methodically, taking the time to understand the underlying system rather than settling for the quickest fix, which made his code easy to trust and build on. He was also a dependable collaborator who communicated clearly, followed through on commitments, and raised issues early rather than letting them surface downstream.

recommendationItems.name: Sabahat Haneef
recommendationItems.headline: Technical Lead @ Expertflow
recommendationItems.relationship: Ma'am Sabahat was my team Lead
recommendationItems.text:
I had the opportunity to work with Nabeel for almost two years, and during this time, he consistently demonstrated exceptional performance. He reliably delivered every assigned task efficiently, on time, and to high standards.

Nabeel played a key role in upgrading our Angular application to the latest version, showing strong technical ownership throughout the process. He also successfully refactored a large and complex component into multiple modular sub-components using a modern architectural approach, without introducing any bugs, which significantly improved maintainability and scalability.

He is never hesitant to work with new technologies and adapts quickly to changing requirements. In addition, he was among the first to take the initiative in adopting TDD and BDD testing practices, showing a strong commitment to writing clean, reliable, and testable code.

One of his strongest qualities is dependability. I could confidently assign him challenging tasks knowing he would put in 100% effort and ensure timely delivery without compromising quality. He is hardworking and continuously improving his skills, especially in AI-related areas, which is highly relevant in today's rapidly evolving tech landscape. I strongly recommend Nabeel as a valuable addition to any team.
